employee_extension_schema.title: VN employee inputs

as_of.description: Exact accrual/request/exit date reviewed. The seed does not treat an earlier date in the month as an exact later-date calculation.

reference.description: Service calculation including sickness up to two months, agreed unpaid leave up to one month, maternity, occupational accident and other art.65 service.

carry_previous_year_days.description: Untaken eligible leave from the immediately preceding year at the start of this year; exact reviewed opening balance, not remaining balance after current-year use. Required, including explicit zero, when annual_leave_combined is true.

carry_second_previous_year_days.description: Untaken eligible leave from two years before at the start of this year; allowed only under the three-year combining agreement. Required, including explicit zero, when annual_leave_combined is true.

domestic_worker.title: Domestic worker
domestic_worker.description: Paid work in a household (Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.161). Outside compulsory SI, HI and UI; the employer pays the insurance-equivalent allowance instead (Law 41/2024/QH15 art.2(2)).

probation_class.title: Probation job class (Labour Code art.25)
probation_class.description: Labour Code 45/2019/QH14 art.25: probation at most 180 days for an enterprise manager (Law on Enterprises, Law on State Capital), 60 days for a job needing college-level or higher qualifications, 30 days for intermediate-level, technical-worker or clerical jobs, 6 working days for any other job. Record it on probation terms.

pass_type.title: Work-permit basis
pass_type.description: INTRA_COMPANY_TRANSFER is outside compulsory SI (Law 41/2024/QH15 art.2(2)).

minor_listed_job.title: A job listed for minors’ overtime and night work

child_arts_sports_approved.title: Under-13 arts or sports work approved
child_arts_sports_approved.description: Labour Code 2019 art.145(3): a child under 13 works only in arts, physical training or sports work with the provincial labour authority’s consent; true records that consent.

special_role_notice.title: Special-role notice period
special_role_notice.description: Decree 145/2020/NĐ-CP art.7 (Labour Code arts.35(1)(d), 36(2)(d)): an aircrew member, aircraft or aviation equipment maintenance staff, flight dispatcher, enterprise manager (Law on Enterprises; Law on State capital), ship crew working abroad or a seafarer on a Vietnamese ship abroad. Notice is at least 120 days for an indefinite or 12-month-plus contract and a quarter of the term for a shorter one.

receiving_pension.description: A worker already receiving a retirement pension: outside compulsory social, health-by-employer and unemployment insurance (Law 41/2024/QH15 art.2), so the SI-equivalent allowance is paid instead.

disabled.description: A person with a disability: fourteen days of annual leave (Labour Code 2019 art.113(1)) and the disabled new-hire unemployment-insurance relief.

salary_vnd.description: Legally established monthly insurance salary before ceilings; actual stoppage salary or part-time monthly earnings, not the unreduced ordinary contract salary (Law 41/2024 art.31).

si_temporarily_suspended.description: True only for the applicable compulsory-SI month of temporary detention/disciplinary suspension under Law 41/2024 art.37(2); ordinary unpaid leave follows its existing rule.

union_dues_exempt.description: Decision 61/QĐ-TLĐ exempt month: SI benefits for at least one month or no-income unpaid personal leave for at least one month.

reference.description: Insurance agency/employment-wage calculation establishing the month, salary, any suspension and arrears. Partial/split-month stoppage is not approximated.
Previous-month contract/allowance evidence; required because earned.previous_month has no historical allowance list.

daily_wage_vnd.description: Contractual daily wage for the month before the exit month (Decree 145/2020 art.67(3)). The exit encashment conversion reads it; zero is refused.

work_authorisation_application_submitted.description: Actual submission date of the pending issue/extension/reissue application. Art35(2) preserves Decree219 treatment only where submitted before2026-12-05; missing is not treated as an old filed application.

work_authorisation_extension_count.description: Number of extensions actually recorded on the current authorisation. Zero selects extension90-day opening; one or more requires a fresh issue application60-day opening (arts9(8),21(3),30). No missing-value zero assumption.

work_location_change_on.description: Actual expected first day at a new or changed stable/regular work location. Permit/certificate holders must notify both authorities at least3 working days earlier (arts10(5),23(5)).

work_authorisation_invalidated_on.description: Actual date the recorded art31(1)/art33(1)-(3) invalidation ground occurred. Natural permit expiry alone is not a mandatory-return ground under art31(1).

work_authorisation_invalidation_ground.description: Documented invalidation ground. PERMIT uses LabourCode156(2)-(7)/Decree393art31(1); certificate uses only Decree393art33(1)-(3). Other authority-decision cases must follow the actual decision; no invented10-day clock.

pension_eligible.title: Qualifies for a pension on leaving
pension_eligible.description: Labour Code 2019 art.46(1): no severance allowance where the employee qualifies for a pension under the social insurance law (Law 41/2024/QH15 art.64).

absent_five_days.title: Dismissed for five days' unexcused absence
absent_five_days.description: Labour Code 2019 art.36(1)(e): the employer ended the contract after five consecutive working days absent without good reason; art.46(1) owes no severance allowance.

final_settlement_extended.title: Settlement period extended to 30 days
final_settlement_extended.description: Labour Code 2019 art.48(1): settlement within 14 working days of termination; only art.48(1)(a)–(d) — the employer ceased operating; restructuring, technological change or economic reasons; a merger, division, sale or transfer; natural disaster, fire, enemy action or epidemic — allow up to 30 days. Unrecorded is the 14-day rule.

unlawful_resignation.title: Left unlawfully
unlawful_resignation.description: Labour Code art.40: a worker who ended the contract unlawfully gets no severance and owes half a month’s wage and the unserved notice.

long_illness.title: Ended for a long illness
long_illness.description: Labour Code 2019 art.36(1)(b): the employer ended the contract because the employee stayed unable to work after the treatment period (12 months indefinite, 6 months fixed term, half the term under 12 months); art.36(2)(c) needs only 3 working days’ notice, whatever the contract term.

statutory.title: Statutory declarations
statutory.description: Employee registrations, exemptions and declared choices captured on this sealed contract.

registration_number.title: SI registration number
registration_number.description: The employee's registration/membership number as issued; keep leading zeros.

si_treaty_exempt.title: Exempt from Vietnamese SI by treaty
si_treaty_exempt.description: SI standing: a foreign employee an international agreement Vietnam is party to exempts (Law 41/2024/QH15 art.2(2)).

registration_number.title: HI registration number
registration_number.description: The employee's registration/membership number as issued; keep leading zeros.

hi_treaty_exempt.description: HI standing only: an applicable international agreement specifically exempts Vietnamese HI under Health Insurance Law art.12(1)(c). SI pension-treaty exemption alone does not establish HI exemption.

registration_number.title: UI registration number
registration_number.description: The employee's registration/membership number as issued; keep leading zeros.

pension_qualified.title: Already qualifies for a pension
pension_qualified.description: UI standing: an employee who qualifies for a pension is outside unemployment insurance (Law 74/2025/QH15 art.31(2)).

disabled_new_hire_relief.title: Disabled new hire registered for the UI relief
disabled_new_hire_relief.description: UI standing: a disabled worker hired from 1 January 2026, registered with the SI agency with the disability certificate; the employer pays 0% UI for 12 months (Decree 374/2025/NĐ-CP art.5).

UNION_FEE.title: Trade Union Fee (Kinh phí công đoàn)

PIT.title: Personal Income Tax (Thuế thu nhập cá nhân)

registration_number.title: PIT registration number
registration_number.description: The employee's registration/membership number as issued; keep leading zeros.

commitment_form.title: Commitment form 08/CK-TNCN filed
commitment_form.description: PIT standing: a resident on no contract or one under three months who expects no taxable income after the family deduction; the 10% withholding is suspended (Decree 253/2026/NĐ-CP art.50(2)).

dependants.title: Registered dependants
dependants.description: PIT standing: each dependant registered with the tax authority is a monthly family deduction of 6,200,000 (Resolution 110/2025).

finalisation_authorised.title: Authorises the employer PIT finalisation
finalisation_authorised.description: PIT standing: the December run finalises the year only for an employee who authorised it and qualifies: one source of salary income under a labour contract of three months or more, still working here when the year is finalised, any other income at most 15,000,000 a month on average with 10% withheld (Decree 253/2026 art.51(1)(b), (2); Decree 126/2020 art.8(6)(d) before). Not for someone claiming a tax reduction or art.49 deductions, who finalises personally (art.51(3)). Set it only when every payment of the tax year is on this payroll, because the finalisation reads the year's balance, and not in a foreign resident's first year here, whose personal deduction runs from the month of arrival (art.48(1)(c)).

voluntary_pension_contribution.title: Voluntary pension / life-insurance contribution (VND a month)
voluntary_pension_contribution.description: PIT standing: the employee’s own monthly contribution to supplementary pension, voluntary pension or life insurance, deducted up to 3,000,000 a month (Decree 253/2026/NĐ-CP art.46(2)(a)).

dependants_registered_from.title: Dependants registered from (one month each)
dependants_registered_from.description: PIT standing: for each registered dependant, the month (YYYY-MM) from which the family deduction applies (Decree 253/2026 art.48(2)(a)); the December finalisation counts each from that month. Leave empty to count the registered dependants for the whole year.

UNION_DUES.title: Đoàn phí công đoàn (union membership dues)

union_member.title: Trade union member
union_member.description: UNION_DUES standing: a member pays 0.5% of the insurance salary, at most 10% of the reference level (Law 50/2024 art.29(1)(a); Decision 61/QĐ-TLĐ).

probation_job_wage_vnd.title: Probation job wage (VND)
probation_job_wage_vnd.description: The wage the same job pays at the end of probation, used for the 85% probation floor.

employee_extension_schema.description: Additional local compliance facts on the sealed contract. Shared salary, allowances, work classifications, dates and work arrangements are native fields.

overtime_300h_sector.title: Eligible for 300 annual overtime hours
overtime_300h_sector.description: Labour Code 2019 art.107(2)(b): at most 200 overtime hours a year; art.107(3) allows 300 only in the listed sectors and cases (Decree 145/2020 art.61), and art.107(4) only after notifying the provincial labour authority. Unrecorded is the general 200-hour limit.

rest_averaged_monthly.title: Rest averaged monthly
rest_averaged_monthly.description: Labour Code 2019 art.111(1): at least 24 consecutive hours of rest each week; only where the work cycle cannot allow weekly rest may the employer average it to at least four days a month. Unrecorded is the weekly rule.

occupational_accident_reduced.title: Approved reduced occupational accident rate
occupational_accident_reduced.description: Decree 58/2020/NĐ-CP art.4(1): the occupational accident and disease fund rate is 0.5% of the salary; the reduced 0.3% applies only to an employer the Ministry approved on application (art.4(1)(b), art.5). Unrecorded is the 0.5% rate.

six_monthly_health_checks.title: Six-monthly health checks
six_monthly_health_checks.description: Law on Occupational Safety and Hygiene 84/2015/QH13 art.21(1): health checks at least once a year, every six months for heavy, hazardous or dangerous work, minors, the disabled and the elderly. Set when the entity employs any of them; unrecorded raises the yearly check only.

work_expense_limit.title: Monthly work-expense allowance limit (internal rules)
work_expense_limit.description: PIT: phone, stationery, travel and work-clothing allowances are taxable only above this level (Decree 253/2026 art.8(2)(đ)). Unrecorded is 0: the whole allowance is taxable.

foreign_worker_database_available.description: Whether the employer foreign-worker information for the reporting period can actually be obtained from the official foreign-worker database. Only actual availability exempts the Decree393art37(6)(dd) periodic report; missing/false keeps the report reminder.

pdpl_exempt.title: Exempt from PDPL dossier and personnel duties
pdpl_exempt.description: Law on Personal Data Protection 91/2025/QH15 art.38(2)–(3): a household business or micro-enterprise is exempt, and a small enterprise or startup may opt out for 5 years from 1 January 2026, from the impact assessment (arts.21–22) and the data-protection personnel (art.33(2)) duties — unless it processes sensitive data or the data of a large number of subjects, or provides data-processing services. Unrecorded is not exempt.

union_fee_quarterly.title: Union fee paid every three months
union_fee_quarterly.description: Decree 105/2026/NĐ-CP art.4(1)(b), (2)(b): an agricultural, forestry, fishery or salt employer paying wages by production cycle may register with the union to pay every three months, by the last day of the month after the cycle. Unrecorded is monthly.

union_fee_reduction_percent.title: Union fee reduction by decision (%)
union_fee_reduction_percent.description: Decree 105/2026/NĐ-CP art.12: after an art.13 suspension ends, an enterprise or cooperative that must still cut its workforce by the art.12(1) threshold may be granted a reduction of at most 20% of the 2% fee (art.12(3)), by month and for at most 6 months (art.12(2)(a)), by decision of the Confederation or the provincial federation. Record the decided percentage only for those months; unrecorded is 0. https://datafiles.chinhphu.vn/cpp/files/vbpq/2026/4/105-ndcp.signed.pdf

union_fee_suspended.title: Union fee suspended by decision
union_fee_suspended.description: Decree 105/2026/NĐ-CP art.13: the Vietnam General Confederation of Labour or the provincial federation may suspend the 2% union fee, by month and for at most 12 months, for an enterprise or cooperative in difficulty from restructuring, technological change, economic crisis, State restructuring policy, natural disaster, fire, epidemic or crop failure that meets art.13(2). Record it only for the decision’s months; unrecorded is the fee in full. https://datafiles.chinhphu.vn/cpp/files/vbpq/2026/4/105-ndcp.signed.pdf

region.title: Worksite minimum-wage region
region.description: The regional minimum wage that applies to the worksite (Decree 399/2026/NĐ-CP art.3). Drives the wage floors, the unemployment-insurance cap and the union dues cap.

first_employed_on.title: First employed on
first_employed_on.description: The day the employer first employed anyone, used for the foreign-worker ratio.

operations_started_on.title: Operations started on
operations_started_on.description: The day the employer began operations.

pit_quarterly_filer.title: Quarterly PIT filer
pit_quarterly_filer.description: The entity files PIT withholding declarations quarterly instead of monthly.
